verified_findings.title: No sentinel guards web/data/menu.js, and no cross-tree mobile<->web parity assertion (test-vs-production gap)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: sed -n '22,24p' tests/js/mobileDataAntiFiction.spec.js => line22 MENU_FILE=resolve(REPO_ROOT,'mobile/data/menu.js'); line23 ORDERS_FILE=mobile/data/orders.js; line24 LOYALTY_FILE=mobile/data/loyalty.js -- all under mobile/. grep -rln 'Downloads/web' tests/js/ => EMPTY (no vitest spec references the web tree). ls /Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/data/ => only menu.js (36142 bytes), outside REPO_ROOT, no equivalent guard. The 'parity' specs found (posKioskVariationParity.spec.js, labelKeyParityFrontend.spec.js) do NOT touch the web tree (grep 'web/data|Downloads/web' on both => EMPTY). ID-bearing mkItem entries: mobile=41, web=41 (byte-identical set today) but hand-maintained mirroring with zero automated cross-tree drift protection. CI vitest.yml runs 'npx vitest run --reporter=verbose' so the mobile sentinel runs, but can only see the mobile tree.
verified_findings.recommendation: Add a small parity sentinel (e.g. tests/js/menuParityMobileWeb.spec.js) that loads both IIFEs and asserts equal item count + per-id (slug,category,name,price) equality + pool counts. The web tree is outside REPO_ROOT (/Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web) so the spec must resolve an absolute path or the web menu.js must be symlinked/copied into the repo for CI to see it -- this is the real friction, not the assertion. No frozen-zone touch. Defer to V1.0.2 polish backlog; not a ship blocker (trees match today).

verified_findings.title: Stale header comment '37 produits visibles' -- actual count is 41

Web counterpart correct: web/data/menu.js:298 '// ITEMS (41 visibles — heal-light V2 2026-05-14)' and web ID-bearing entries also = 41. Pure documentation drift -- the comment is descriptive, not executed; no render or logic impact.
verified_findings.recommendation: One-line comment fix: '37 produits visibles' -> '41 produits visibles' to match the web header (line 298) and reality. Trivial, no frozen-zone, no functional change. Bundle into the parity-sentinel PR or any future menu touch.
